name: Frequency Shifter
description: Single-sideband frequency shifter: moves every partial by the same number of hertz, from slow phasing drift to bell tones, with a delayed feedback path for barber-pole spirals.

params.name: Shift
params.description: Moves every partial by the same amount. Small shifts beat and phase against the dry sound; large ones turn notes into clangy, bell-like tones.

params.name: Fine
params.description: A small extra shift added to Shift, for setting slow phasing and beating precisely.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Up and Down set the direction of the shift. Stereo shifts the left up and the right down. Ring gives both at once, as a ring modulator does.

params.name: Feedback
params.description: Sends the shifted sound back through the delay to be shifted again, so each pass climbs or falls further into a spiral.

params.name: Delay
params.description: The time each feedback pass takes. Short gives a rising or falling comb, the barber pole. Long gives echoes that step in pitch.

params.name: LFO Rate
params.description: How fast the LFO sways the amount of shift.

params.name: LFO Depth
params.description: How far the LFO sways the amount of shift. Low settings give a slow drift in the phasing; high settings a clear wobble.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Darkens the feedback path, so every pass round the loop loses more highs. The first shifted sound is not affected.

params.name: Width
params.description: Turns the right side out of step with the left. The sound widens and the beating against the dry signal moves between the sides.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry and the shifted signal. Slow phasing needs both, so it is strongest near the middle.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A Bode-style single-sideband shifter (Hilbert pair times a quadrature carrier) with the delayed, filtered feedback path of the later rack shifters; not a model of any one unit.
